# Unfoldinn

> Mentoring Young Minds. Preparing Them for Life Beyond the Classroom.
> Young Minds. New Perspectives. Wider Possibilities.

Unfoldinn is an independent mentoring practice and conversational guidance platform founded by Deepak Sogani. It provides private, human-led conversations for young people aged 16–25 navigating educational choices, career crossroads, personal confidence, and life transitions.

## Summary Facts
- **Organization Name**: Unfoldinn
- **Founder & Lead Mentor**: Deepak Sogani
- **Background**: 35+ years of experience spanning corporate leadership, entrepreneurship, and higher education (including former Head of Student Affairs at JK Lakshmipat University).
- **Location**: Jaipur, Rajasthan, India (Delivering online 1-on-1 sessions pan-India and globally via Google Meet).
- **Official Domain**: https://www.unfoldinn.com
- **Official Email**: unfoldinn26@gmail.com
- **Helpline / WhatsApp**: +91 77372 20724

## What Makes Unfoldinn Different
- **Not an EdTech Course or Coaching Center**: No pre-packaged videos, no pressure to pick a specific stream, and no commission from colleges.
- **Human-Led & Independent**: Unhurried, 1-on-1 conversations focused on self-understanding, exposure, and ownership of decisions.
- **Complimentary First Conversation**: The initial conversation is complimentary to ensure comfort and alignment.

## Core Target Audiences
1. **Students (Ages 16–25)**: Navigating stream selection after 10th/12th, degree confusion, placement dilemmas, job vs. masters choices, gap years, and interview confidence.
2. **Parents**: Parents seeking an independent, empathetic sounding board for their child without family friction or pressure.
3. **Educational Institutions**: Schools and universities looking for holistic student development workshops and life-readiness programs.
